TAL_GUARDIAN_STAND_AGAINST_THE_CALAMITY.why: Stand Against the Calamity: a planted 30-foot aura -- allies inside +2 AC, Advantage on saves and your Proficiency Bonus off all damage, structures and Formation Anchors Resistance; an enemy forcibly moving one creature inside makes a Strength save (failure stops it, success halves it); ends if you become Incapacitated or willingly move (combat/ext/guardian_calamity.py).
